changeSet.author: ttn
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE violation ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), rule_definition_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES rule_definition(id), rule_version INT NOT NULL, review_job_id UUID REFERENCES review_job(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, company_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, entity_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, entity_ref VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, entity_no VARCHAR(50), entity_date DATE, severity VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(25) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('OPEN','EXPLAINED','PROPOSED','RESOLVED_PENDING_ERP','RESOLVED','DISMISSED')), message TEXT NOT NULL, evidence JSONB NOT NULL, fingerprint CHAR(64) NOT NULL, detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ, dismissed_by UUID REFERENCES app_user(id), dismiss_reason TEXT, CONSTRAINT uk_violation_fingerprint UNIQUE (fingerprint) ); CREATE INDEX idx_violation_company_status ON violation (company_id, status, severity); CREATE INDEX idx_violation_entity ON violation (entity_type, entity_ref); CREATE INDEX idx_violation_review_job ON violation (review_job_id); CREATE INDEX idx_violation_entity_date ON violation (company_id, entity_date);
